topic_summary: Analysis of the abortion debate as a contested kernel where different parties read the personhood-boundary commitment differently. The conception reading, viability reading, and birth reading each instantiate structurally different constraints with distinct victim sets, beneficiary structures, and authority groundings.

key_entities: Fetus/embryo (entity whose moral status is contested)
Pregnant person (rights-holder in all readings, scope varies)
State authority (enforcer of whichever reading prevails)
Religious institutions (natural-law authority grounding for conception reading)
Autonomy framework (liberal rights grounding for birth reading)
key_tensions: Fetal moral status vs maternal autonomy (victim-set boundary dispute)
Natural law vs positive law (authority grounding collision)
Fixed boundary vs developmental continuum (kernel stability vs gradualism)

axes.structural_delta: Personhood begins at conception; fetus enters victim set immediately; abortion is homicide
axes.primary_observable: Legal personhood statutes; fetal homicide laws; abortion prohibition scope
axes.selection_reason: Highest extractiveness; most restrictive victim-set boundary; canonical natural-law reading

axes.human_readable: Viability Reading (Moral Status at Independent Survival Threshold)
axes.structural_delta: Personhood begins at viability (~24 weeks); pre-viability abortion permitted; post-viability restricted
axes.primary_observable: Gestational age limits in abortion law; medical viability definitions; Roe v Wade framework
axes.selection_reason: Intermediate position; medical-authority grounding; distinct from both poles

axes.structural_delta: Personhood begins at birth; fetus not in victim set; pregnant person sole rights-holder
axes.primary_observable: Abortion access laws; gestational limits (none or very late); autonomy-based legal frameworks
axes.selection_reason: Autonomy-maximizing pole; lowest extractiveness; positivist grounding

axes.human_readable: Sentience Reading (Moral Status at Neural Capacity)
axes.structural_delta: Personhood begins at sentience/pain capacity (~20 weeks); pre-sentience abortion unrestricted
axes.primary_observable: Fetal pain legislation; neural development thresholds; utilitarian ethical frameworks
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: overlaps structurally with viability reading; lower centrality; utilitarian rather than rights-based

deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Overlaps with viability reading in practical implementation; utilitarian grounding less structurally distinct than natural-law vs autonomy poles

omegas.description: Does the kernel's fixity requirement collapse under developmental biology? If personhood is genuinely gradual, all three readings are arbitrary line-drawing rather than kernel interpretations.
Conception reading requires state surveillance of pregnancy outcomes; birth reading does not. Is the extractiveness difference structural (snare vs mountain) or implementation-dependent?
Historical quickening standard (fetal movement ~16-20 weeks) was dominant pre-modern reading. Its absence from current debate suggests authority-structure shift rather than kernel stability.
All three readings emerged from male-dominated interpretive authorities (church, court, legislature). Does a feminist reading of the kernel exist, or does patriarchal authority structure preclude it?

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Kernel structure confirmed: three readings share personhood-boundary substrate but emit constraints with different victim sets, epsilon values, and authority groundings. Sentience reading deferred as structurally redundant with viability.

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The personhood-boundary kernel: a shared commitment that moral status attaches at some point in fetal development, contested over where that boundary lies
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Natural-law (religious/metaphysical), medical-professional (viability), and autonomy-liberal (positivist) authority structures compete for interpretive legitimacy

readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus in victim set from conception; abortion prohibited or heavily restricted; high state enforcement extractiveness; pregnant person's autonomy subordinated

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at viability (capacity for independent survival)
readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus enters victim set at ~24 weeks; pre-viability abortion permitted; post-viability restricted; moderate state role; balancing framework

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at birth (exit from maternal body)
readings.expected_structural_delta: Fetus not in victim set until birth; pregnant person sole rights-holder; minimal state enforcement; abortion unrestricted or very late limits
